text: List view: dragging an idea into another list looked done but was never saved

status.comment: Fixed in IdeasList.vue; spec components/__tests__/IdeasList.spec.ts mounts two lists in one app and asserts distinct groups (fails without the fix, passes with it). pnpm check 25/25. Not tried by hand in the browser.

description: IdeasList shared one vuedraggable group ("ideas") across all lists, but handleChange saves only `moved` events. Dropping an idea into another list (another phase or parent) changed both lists' local copies, saved nothing, and left the screen out of sync until reload. Fix: each list gets its own group (`ideas-${useId()}`), so drag only reorders within its list. Whether a drag should re-parent is left open (920b1921 / Felix).
